title: Distribute Coins in Binary Tree
summary: Given a binary tree with n nodes, each having a certain number of coins, distribute the coins such that each node has exactly one coin.
statement: Given a binary tree with n nodes, each having a certain number of coins, distribute the coins such that each node has exactly one coin. In one move, you can transfer one coin between adjacent nodes. Calculate the minimum number of moves needed to achieve this distribution.
constraints: The tree has n nodes and exactly n coins total.
One move transfers one coin across one parent-child edge; return minimum moves.

reference_solution:
def distribute_tree_coins(root):
 moves=0
 def balance(node):
  nonlocal moves
  if node is None:return 0
  left=balance(node.left);right=balance(node.right);moves+=abs(left)+abs(right)
  return node.val+left+right-1
 balance(root);return moves
